name: Kenco MCS Dallas II - Lancaster TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster gives identical APPROXIMATE coords for three Kenco Lancaster facilities (Dallas III/IV/II = 589,362 / 560,000 / 200,000 SF) in the Danieldale Road multi-tenant logistics corridor, Lancaster TX 75134. Per-building Kenco leasing is not publicly disambiguated. idx 14 (Dallas II, 200,000 SF - the smallest of the three) was assigned to the notably smaller rear-load building in the corridor, center ~32.6325,-96.8038.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open speculative-park access drives off the corridor street - no barrier arm, no gate, no guard booth. Street View shows wide open paved entrance drives with only fire-lane striping.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Rear-load building with a single dock bank along its east face only - shipping and receiving share one dock cluster.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop / parking area along the east dock apron with ~25 trailers parked.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Single east-face dock bank on a ~200,000 SF rear-load building; estimated 25-50 band (~38 doors). Overhead estimate, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Large multi-building logistics park; Kenco occupies three buildings in the corridor. True at campus level.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide aprons and drives leave room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lancaster TX, a southern Dallas-Fort Worth metro suburb in dense industrial fabric. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.confidence: Medium - corridor and Kenco presence confirmed; the three same-coord Kenco Lancaster facilities cannot be individually pinned from public data. idx 14 reflects the smallest (rear-load) building in the cluster.
